title: Database Snapshot
description: Learn how to create and use database snapshots for quick recovery and reporting.

data.text: A database snapshot is a read-only, static view of a database. It captures the state of the source database at the moment of creation and grows as changes are made to the source.

data.content: Reverts the HR database to its snapshot state.

data.title: Database Snapshot Key Points
points: Database snapshots are read-only and static views of a database.
They grow as changes are made to the source database.
Use CREATE DATABASE ... AS SNAPSHOT to create a snapshot.
Use RESTORE DATABASE ... FROM DATABASE_SNAPSHOT to revert.
Snapshots are not substitutes for backups.
